description: Cognitive memory MCP server with vector search, knowledge graph, lifecycle management, and hierarchical expert routing. Install as a dotnet global tool for single-line setup.
releaseNotes: 2.0.0 is a breaking release for hosts embedding McpEngramMemory.Core: tenantId is now a required argument on 55 Core retrieval and scoping APIs. The MCP tool surface and on-disk data are unchanged. Release notes: https://github.com/wyckit/mcp-engram-memory/blob/main/docs/release-notes-2.0.0.md
